answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

一张横向分组条形图：6 个类别（Significantly lower … Prefer not to answer），每类两根条（2024 深蓝、2022 青色），图例在图上方一行。没有数值轴、没有刻度、没有网格，只有类别之间的浅色分隔横线；每根条右端印数字（长条为内侧白字，短条如 `1` 为外侧黑字）。标题分两层：`Partner turnover (%)` 与一整句问题式副标题。左侧另有一栏正文 `Partner turnover`，与图并排。图下两行小字 Note / Source。

**定位一个值难在哪**

取 `6`：它在图上出现两次——`Significantly higher` 的 2022 条与 `Prefer not to answer` 的 2022 条。只有同时给出类别名与图例年份（`2022`）才能唯一定位；若解析器只输出「6」和一个类别名，就会指错行。数值本身是印刷的，读数不成问题。

**不确定的**

图无编号，`Figure` 字样是否在别处出现无法判断；条长与数字是否严格成比例（无轴可校验）；`1` 那根深蓝条极短，是否还有更细的描边或标记无法看清。

heading.title: Partner turnover (%)
heading.subtitle: In your most recent fiscal year, how much partner turnover was there at your firm compared to your expectations at the beginning of the fiscal year?

axes.serves: all bars, one category row each

worked_example.why_hard: The value 6 also appears for 'Prefer not to answer' 2022; category plus year both required.

figures.type_other: side text column: a heading and a paragraph of body prose, not a figure

worked_example.value: 49% of respondents said partner turnover was higher or significantly higher
worked_example.why_hard: Prose, not a mark; no chart address exists.

components.evidence: two bars per row, dark 2024 above light 2022, in each category slot
category names on the left, bars grow rightward from a common left edge
no ticks or numbers along any value axis; only printed labels give the numbers
'27', '35', '45' printed in white at the right end inside the bars
'1' printed in black just right of the very short dark 2024 bar
'2024' and '2022' swatches sit between the question subtitle and the first bar row
'Note: Numbers may not sum to 100%, because of rounding.' and 'Source: Heidrick & Struggles US ... n=144'
left column 'Partner turnover' plus paragraph runs level with the chart
title reads 'Partner turnover (%)'; no unit appears anywhere on the plot
long labels 'Significantly higher', 'Prefer not to answer' stacked down the left
thin horizontal rules separate each category row; no vertical rules

appears twice: 'Significantly higher' 2022 bar and 'Prefer not to answer' 2022 bar

answer.hardest_step_why: 数值全部印在条上，读数无碍；但 14 和 6 各出现两次，必须同时匹配类别名与图例年份 2024/2022 才能唯一定位。

examples.quote: 'Partner turnover (%)' above 'In your most recent fiscal year, how much partner turnover was there at your firm...'
examples.why: 标题拆成标题行、括号单位与整句问题副标题，现有流程只有单一 title 字段。

examples.quote: '1' printed in black outside the short dark bar; '45' printed in white inside the long bar
examples.why: 同一图内标签位置随条长切换内外并改字色，现无此规则。

examples.quote: Left column heading 'Partner turnover' with prose runs level with the chart's plot area
examples.why: 整页导出需记录并排文本栏与图的相对位置。

examples.quote: No value axis, no ticks; only thin horizontal rules between the six category rows
examples.why: 需支持完全无值轴、仅靠印刷标签读数的条形图样式；现有生成器默认画轴。
